_about: The ontology's identity: its release rises on every published change, `extends` names what it composes on top of, `carries` what the directory holds.
name: factory-run
summary: A factory run's own graph (roadmap I8, J4): the plan instance, a build per component with its state, and every iteration of the loop with its verdict and gaps, kept in full so a run replays; written by the engine from what the hooks record, never by hand or by a model, and promoted into the main graph only as a result.

changelog.note: Iteration.tests (what the tests said, beside the verdict) and FR4, FR5: where the evaluator and the tests disagreed (roadmap J6).
First release (roadmap I8, J4): Run, Build, Iteration; FR1 to FR3.
